def get_openapi_security_definitions(
    flat_dependant: Dependant,
) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
    security_definitions = {}
    operation_security = []
    for security_requirement in flat_dependant.security_requirements:
        security_definition = jsonable_encoder(
            security_requirement.security_scheme.model,
            by_alias=True,
            exclude_none=True,
        )
        security_name = security_requirement.security_scheme.scheme_name
        security_definitions[security_name] = security_definition
        operation_security.append({security_name: security_requirement.scopes})
    return security_definitions, operation_security

+def _merge_security_definition(
+    existing: Dict[str, Any], new: Dict[str, Any]
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    # The same security scheme name can be declared with different OAuth2 scopes
+    # (e.g. by different path operations). Merge their scopes into one definition
+    # instead of letting the last one overwrite the others.
+    existing_flows = existing.get("flows")
+    new_flows = new.get("flows")
+    if not isinstance(existing_flows, dict) or not isinstance(new_flows, dict):
+        return new
+    for flow_name, new_flow in new_flows.items():
+        existing_flow = existing_flows.get(flow_name)
+        if not isinstance(existing_flow, dict) or not isinstance(new_flow, dict):
+            existing_flows[flow_name] = new_flow
+            continue
+        existing_scopes = existing_flow.setdefault("scopes", {})
+        for scope, description in new_flow.get("scopes", {}).items():
+            existing_scopes.setdefault(scope, description)
+    return existing
